alt: 孩子輕輕替熟睡的奶奶蓋好毯子，將眼鏡收妥、拖鞋擺順，並把溫熱飲品放在伸手可及的地方。
scene_prompt: 體貼入微 means thoughtfully caring for another person's tiny needs with meticulous attention. Contemporary cozy living room. An older child notices grandmother asleep in an armchair and quietly tends to her comfort: gently tucks a light knitted blanket around grandmother's knees and feet while avoiding waking her. On the side table the child has already placed grandmother's eyeglasses safely in their open case and a warm mug on a coaster within easy reach; slippers are neatly turned toward her feet. A slightly open curtain softens glare from the window, showing careful attention to small details. The child's face is tender and considerate, grandmother peacefully relaxed. Only two figures, child's hands naturally holding opposite blanket edges, exactly two arms and legs each, blanket drapes with gravity and armchair supports body plausibly. No hospital equipment, no illness emergency, no text, letters, numerals or speech bubbles. Hand-drawn pencil and soft watercolor on ivory paper.
